senses.definition: (figurative, of a story, etc.) Exciting; titillating.
examples: I do not keep up with all the latest juicy rumors.
I like getting my teeth into a nice juicy problem.

quotes.text: If you’re looking for juicier confessions – that is, admissions of the kinds of sins unearthed on detective shows or reality TV – then you’ll want to look elsewhere. My sinning life is rather uneventful.

senses.definition: (slang) Voluptuous, curvy, thick; sexy in those ways.
(of a blow, strike, etc., uncommon) Strong; thus, also painful.

quotes.text:
“Your head feels funny, doesn't it?”
“It does rather,” I said, the bump I had given it had been a juicy one, and the temples were throbbing.
